description: This file 'GatewayConnection.swift' contains the implementation of a singleton actor that manages a websocket connection to a gateway server in a Swift-based application. It defines enums for channels and methods, handles requests and responses, manages subscriptions, and provides various high-level API functions for sending messages, managing sessions, skills, cron jobs, and health checks.

classes.name: GatewayConnection
classes.description: A singleton actor managing the websocket connection to the gateway, handling requests, responses, and subscriptions, providing high-level API functions for communication, management, and health monitoring.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the gateway with specified method, params, and timeout, handling retries and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: requestRaw
methods.description: Sends a raw request to the gateway with a specific method and parameters, returning the raw Data.

methods.name: requestDecoded
methods.description: Performs a request and decodes the response into a specified Decodable type.

methods.name: requestVoid
methods.description: Performs a request expecting no return value; used for commands without response data.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous stream to listen for GatewayPush updates, including snapshots.

methods.name: mainSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves or fetches the current main session key, querying the gateway if necessary.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks the health status of the gateway connection.

methods.name: sendAgent
methods.description: Sends a message through the gateway, with session management and channel controls.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Sends a system event to the gateway with specific parameters.

methods.name: healthSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches a health snapshot from the gateway, decoding it into a HealthSnapshot object.

methods.name: skillsStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status report of installed skills.

methods.name: skillsInstall
methods.description: Installs a skill with specific parameters, returning the result.

methods.name: skillsUpdate
methods.description: Updates the configuration of a specified skill.

methods.name: sessionsPreview
methods.description: Previews session data for given session keys.

methods.name: chatHistory
methods.description: Retrieves chat history for a specified session.

methods.name: chatSend
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional attachments.

methods.name: chatAbort
methods.description: Aborts a chat run by runId within a session.

methods.name: talkMode
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode.

methods.name: voiceWakeGetTriggers
methods.description: Fetches voice wake triggers.

methods.name: voiceWakeSetTriggers
methods.description: Sets voice wake triggers.

methods.name: nodePairApprove
methods.description: Approves a node pairing request.

methods.name: nodePairReject
methods.description: Rejects a node pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairApprove
methods.description: Approves a device pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairReject
methods.description: Rejects a device pairing request.

methods.name: cronStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the cron scheduler.

methods.name: cronList
methods.description: Lists cron jobs, optionally including disabled ones.

methods.name: cronRuns
methods.description: Retrieves recent runs of a specific cron job.

methods.name: cronRun
methods.description: Triggers a run of a specific cron job, optionally forcing it.

methods.name: cronRemove
methods.description: Removes a cron job.

methods.name: cronUpdate
methods.description: Updates a cron job with a patch.

methods.name: cronAdd
methods.description: Adds a new cron job.
